The '''HT-50 Heated Crate''' was a model of [[hot box]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. Equipped with a [[heating unit]] in the base, it was capable of keeping cargo warm during transit. The HT-50 cost two-hundred and fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="PSG" />
